adjudication.rationale: In `Post#cook`, the new early return `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` bypasses the subsequent `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` call, so any `after_post_cook` plugin filters will not run for `raw_html` posts (e.g., those created via `TopicEmbed.import` passing `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). This is a real, diff-grounded behavioral change affecting extensibility, but the diff comments suggest it may be intentional to skip the cooking pipeline, so it's not unequivocally a defect.
